title: Janakiraman
desc: Two brothers remain sworn to bachelorhood. However, chaos arises when a man tries to get them married to his daughters.

title: Muraimaman
desc: When his eloped sister and her lover return, Sirius and his brother welcome them. Later, Sirius falls in love with his sister's daughter, Indhu.

title: Kaakha Kaakha
desc: ACP Anbuselvan succeeds in killing a dreaded gangster but Pandya, the gangster's brother, kills Maya, Anbuselvan's wife. Later, Anbuselvan goes all out to finish Pandya and his gang.

title: Kochadaiyaan
desc: Rana, a belligerent warrior, declares war against his kingdom's ruler to avenge his father's death, unexpectedly making a new enemy in the process.

title: Rajadurai
desc: Rajadurai, a police officer, succeeds in capturing Mayandi, a gangster, and sending him to jail. Later, Mayandi kidnaps Rajadurai's son, Vijay, and raises him as a criminal.
